findings.title: Single-node failure domains: API, worker, Redis and DB proxy co-resident
findings.impact: Node loss takes all services down together.
findings.recommendation: Define failure domains and a warm standby; schedule chaos tests.

findings.title: Chaos and load tests are not part of a scheduled pipeline
findings.note: Tests exist under tests/chaos and tests/k6 but no schedule.
evidence: workflows have no schedule trigger for them
findings.recommendation: Add a nightly chaos/load budget run.

report:
Reviewed chaos scenarios, Redis recovery
and single-node failure modes. Chaos/k6 assets exist but are not scheduled.
